metadata.note: This is the shape framework §12.4 now uses for its exception profile template: an exception intent pointing at schema/v1/intent.json, replacing the schema/v1/exception.json URL that §12.4 advertised from v1.0 but never published. Restricted cannot exceed R and M here: Add, Change and Delete on Restricted are the §12.5 immutable floor and no grant can reach them. Adjudication computes how much scrutiny this request needs; the §12.2 authority still decides whether to grant it (N-37).
